study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial (cohort study design)
exposure: duration of the second stage of labor
duration of the third stage of labor
cohort: The study included women from three university hospitals in France, aged at least 18 years, with a singleton pregnancy, in the first stage of labor, at 36-42 weeks of gestation, with epidural anesthesia and a vaginal delivery.
finding: The duration of oxytocin exposure and the third stage of labor were risk factors for PPH in nulliparous women, while the duration of the third stage and a history of PPH were risk factors in parous women.
